metadata.title: COMING SOON: मध्य प्रदेश से कहानियां जल्द | Ground Reports from Madhya Pradesh | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Main Bhi Bharat team is in Madhya Pradesh, and today visited the MP-Maharashtra border district of Badwani. We met the people of the Bhil, Barela and Bhilala tribes here. 
We present to you a tiny glimpse of what's to come. We will talk about their culture, their livelihood, the issues affecting them. 
Thank you for your continued support! 

#Main_Bhi_Bharat #MBB_in_MP #Madhya_Pradesh
